entries.backgroundDescription: A storm-soaked boundary between a burned forest slope and an intact wildflower clearing. Charred fallen logs with glowing orange embers cross the lower edge around gray mossy rocks and dark wet soil beneath the wide stance. An intact patch of white, purple and yellow wildflowers opens behind the legs toward image right, contrasting with scorched trunks and burned debris on image left. Rain-veiled forest slopes and bare trunks lie beneath heavy gray storm clouds, with branching white lightning high on image right. Cold storm light and a bright lightning flash define the wet silhouette, while restrained orange ember glow warms small areas of the charred foreground.

entries.backgroundDescription: An open high grass ridge above a broad misty wilderness valley at dawn. Flat gray stones, short grass and small yellow flowers break up the ridge under the forward foot and lifted rear heel. Long straw-colored grasses bend across the sloping ridge and descend toward scattered young conifers. Horizontal ribbons of pale mist separate treelines, open fields and distant low hills across the wide valley beneath a peach-pink clouded sky. Soft pale sunrise light enters from the far right, warming the grass and mask edges while the valley remains muted beneath cool bands of morning mist.
